## What & why

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New behaviour is behind a feature flag (`src/flags.ts`), off by default
- [ ] Tile format changes bump `FORMAT_VERSION` and stay backward-readable
- [ ] No personal data, home locations, secrets, keys, server IPs or internal paths
- [ ] Imagery/data sources are openly licensed (no Google/Apple/Bing imagery)
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/)
